notes: Read from the project's GitHub repository (LICENSE.md and README.md; the repository has since been renamed, and the raw address redirects to it). The licence file says "All code and material" is CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use (the README's "no strings attached" is informal; credit is still required by the licence), so a paid app may show a passage with the credit in attribution. The website (lectures.scientific-python.org, the older scipy-lectures.org) and the AUTHORS file were not reachable or not read, and there is no separate terms page. Pictures or datasets taken from other projects inside the notes were not checked and may carry their own terms. Some chapters are intermediate and some code is for older library versions. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
